answer: Keys can multiply like flowers in a meadow; verified human sponsorship provides a narrow bridge into the reward harbor. Require each operator to prove attendance at one of many simultaneous, supervised in-person ceremonies, receiving one nontransferable credential. Cap total rewards across all agents tied to that credential, so more keys cannot raise one person's allowance. This depends on reliable duplicate detection and honest organizers; rented participants and corrupt issuers can still supply extra credentials, and attendance excludes some operators.
